wa_leave_my_flake_alone.notes: Shares the start with Mourning Star, then trends about 20 ft right to Zoom is anchor.
About 70 ft. Blocky bolted climbing, traverses right under a small roof to a triangular belay ledge (often wet).
The Flake pitch, about 50 ft. Tricky and reachy off the belay, follows a flake system to the top.

wa_liberty_bell_girl_next_door.notes: Start from the treed ledge reached by walking part way up the side gully with the large cave, on climber's left below the Liberty-Concord notch. Climb the low-angle face of the rock rib to a good stance directly below the steeper second pitch.

Follow a steepening finger crack up and right until it fades, then find feet out left and make a committing, balancy move across to a second crack system. Easier ground above passes the very sandy ledge called Kitty Litter Pillar, then a traverse reaches the tree at the top of the Beckey Route's second pitch. Extra finger-size pieces are useful.

Cross low-angle slabs to the steeper crack system on the left and climb it to the top of the arete, where the route rejoins the Beckey Route for the finish. The easier climbing on this pitch is on poorer rock than P2, so test holds.
